training.selection: Three entire-frame development folds; choose smallest forest within 0.005 pooled IoU of best; lowest threshold wins ties
training.input: Whole-pillar sufficient statistics and neighboring raster summaries; no reference labels at runtime

fixedStatisticalGate.reason: A target traffic-sign pillar necessarily contains at least one return above the configured 1600 intensity threshold. This gate operates on the whole-pillar maximum and adds no point validation.

statisticalGate.reason: A target traffic-sign pillar necessarily contains at least one return above the configured 1600 intensity threshold. This gate operates on the whole-pillar maximum and adds no point validation.
